newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor prices steady in a narrow price range.
newsitem.headline: India castor prices steady in a narrow price range.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Friday held steady at 1,100/1,102 rupees per quintal in a narrow price band, dealers said.
Spot prices at producing centres however firmed on a drop in the arrivals but it had little impact on the Bombay market, they said.
Gujarat region spot prices of castorseed rose by two rupees at 218/219 rupees per 20 kg as arrivals fell to 25,000 bags (75 kg each) against 30,000 bags reported on Thursday.
Groundnut oil fell to 358/360 rupees per 10 kg from 363/365 rupees on the back of improved summer crop arrivals as well as higher supplies of imported edible oil at the Bombay port.
Imported plam-oil fell by 1/2 rupees at 282/283 rupees per 10 kg on fresh arrivals and subdued trend in the world market.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 560 rupees per 15 kg. But June delivery was quoted lower at 550 rupees.
